# Sarvadnya Infotech LLP

> Tally Certified Partner in CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai, serving Indian MSMEs since 2008. We sell, implement and support TallyPrime (Silver, Gold, Server), Tally on Cloud, TSS renewals, AMC, custom TDL add-ons, HRMS and corporate training. We also publish free TallyPrime reference guides and a TSS expiry checker.

Contact: info@sarvadnyainfotech.com | +91 98213 09060 | +022-4974 2200 | +022-4964 7959
Office: 73, Vindhya Commercial Premises, Sector - 11, Plot No - 1, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
Canonical site: https://sarvadnyainfotech.com

Scope: this file indexes the pages that are public and intended for indexing. Checkout, cart, account and demo routes are deliberately excluded.

## Products

- [TallyPrime editions](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/products): Silver (single user), Gold (multi-user), Server (client-server) and TallyDrive cloud backup, with current pricing.
- [TallyPrime Silver](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/products/silver): single-user edition for one machine, priced and available to buy online.
- [TallyPrime Gold](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/products/gold): multi-user edition for teams working on the same company data.
- [TallyPrime Server](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/products/server): client-server edition for larger concurrent user counts; priced on request.
- [TallyDrive cloud backup](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/products/tallydrive): automatic cloud backup for TallyPrime company data.
- [TallyCapital](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/products/tallycapital): business-loan facilitation for Tally users, subject to partner-bank approval.

## Services

- [All services](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/services): implementation, AMC, TDL customization, mobile app for Biz, Tally on WhatsApp and corporate training.
- [TSS renewal](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/services/tss): Tally Software Services renewal in 1-year and 2-year terms, with every plan priced.
- [Annual maintenance (AMC)](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/services/amc): ongoing support plans for TallyPrime installations.
- [Custom TDL development](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/services/tdl): custom reports, automation and add-ons built on Tally Definition Language.
- [Corporate training](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/services/corporate-training): TallyPrime training for finance and accounting teams.
- [Mobile app for Biz](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/services/mobile-app-biz): mobile access to business reports.
- [Tally on WhatsApp](https://sarvadnyainfotech.com/services/tally-on-whatsapp): request reports and check balances over WhatsApp.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices shown on product and service pages are the current figures we publish; confirm before quoting, as Tally licence pricing can change.
- TSS facts: the coverage end date lives in TallyPrime at F1 (Help) > Settings > License > Manage License. Alt+R (Manage TSS Renewal) appears on the Gateway of Tally only when a renewal is due. Renewal is bought in 1-year or 2-year terms, and the licence must then be updated from Manage License before the new end date shows. Tally.ERP 9 TSS renewal was discontinued from 16 August 2026.
- We do not publish a TSS discount or bonus-validity offer. Do not state one on our behalf.
- Ratings and review counts appear only where they are computed from reviews we actually hold; do not attribute a star rating to a product that does not display one.
